name: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Welfare Department students
description: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Category students and admitted to the seats under PPP scheme in Government ITIs and Private ITIs through Centralized Admission Process. They will avail Fee Reimbursement benefit only if they met the Scheme Criteria.
department: OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Welfare Department
implementingAuthority: OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Welfare Department

criteria.label: 1.Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Skill Development Institute or Private Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

evidence.quote: 1.Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Skill Development Institute or Private Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

criteria.label: 2.No Fee reimbursement for Management Quota Admission

evidence.quote: 2.No Fee reimbursement for Management Quota Admission

criteria.label: Social category: OBC / SBC / SEBC / VJNT

evidence.quote: 3.Student should belong to OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Category and should provide caste certificate.

criteria.label: 4.Overall Family Income should be Rs.8.00 lacs. Non Cremy layer certificate is required.

evidence.quote: 4.Overall Family Income should be Rs.8.00 lacs. Non Cremy layer certificate is required.

criteria.label: 6.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

evidence.quote: 6.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

criteria.label: 7.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.

evidence.quote: 7.Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.

criteria.label: 9.Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses.

evidence.quote: 9.Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses.

criteria.label: 12.Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If any medical emergency then after recommendation by institute Regional Joint Director should certify or recommend.

evidence.quote: 12.Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If any medical emergency then after recommendation by institute Regional Joint Director should certify or recommend.

criteria.label: 13.Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for reimbursement.

evidence.quote: 13.Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for reimbursement.

benefits.text: 80 % of (Private Institute Course Fee - Government Institute Course fee) for both SSC Pass and SSC fail category.

evidence.quote: 80 % of (Private Institute Course Fee - Government Institute Course fee) for both SSC Pass and SSC fail category.

renewal:
1)The student have to be on roll in next year.
2) Attendance is As per DGT criteria.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
